svg.title: The aws-chatbot abstraction iceberg
svg.desc: An abstraction iceberg with 4 layers below the waterline and 90 managed resources in total. Depth 1: chatbot (20). Depth 2: app_infra · atlas_aws · atlas_cluster · atlas_project · ecs_service (25). Depth 3: backup_export · backup_schedule · cloud_provider_access · encryption · encryption_private_endpoint · http_edge · ip_access_list · log_integration · privatelink · vpc (39). Depth 4: vpc (6).
svg.text: no default, so the caller must set them
have a default, so the caller may skip them
Above the waterline: what you write
further from the module call you write
example 70 · us-east-1 · what the module call declares, and what the module declares for you
1 module call → 90 managed resources across 4 levels

Counts are managed resource instances in example 70's terraform.tfstate, grouped by module depth. The example enables every feature except internet_egress, so no NAT gateway appears. Required inputs are variables with no default.
